title: Man. Post. Cap. VIII: event reply — Adam for ban, posterity for inherent vice; tip
pass_a_gloss: But you argue from the event: when the ban was broken, Adam and all posterity were made liable to death. Certainly—but Adam immediately for the ban he himself violated; posterity for the vice and sin that, propagated from Adam, inheres in each. Tip before the sentence/common-penalty syllogism.
pass_b_english: But you argue from the event. For this—when the interdict was violated, both Adam and all posterity were made liable to death. Certainly: but Adam immediately for the interdict violated by himself, posterity for the vice and sin which, propagated from Adam, inheres in each.
source_text: Verum tu argumentaris ab eventu. Hoc enim violato interdicto & Adam & omnes posteri morti obnoxii facti sunt. Certe, sed Adam immediate ob violatum a se interdictum, posteri ob vitium & peccatum quod singulis ab Adamo propagatum inhaeret.

choices.choice: Adam for ban; posterity for inherent vice; tip before sentence syllogism
